answers: The Marketing thought buttons can be omitted, just like cell phones, because many of the functions of buttons, such as the TV button, are generally not used. But they can set up a menu-style button if they really need to.
turn_texts: The Marketing person thought that the remote control should have fewer buttons, suggesting a menu-based system or a design that is less crowded, similar to modern phones that have fewer physical buttons. They believed that having too many buttons could confuse users and that functionality not frequently used could be handled through a menu or screen interface rather than physical buttons.
